gloss: to stimulate; to irritate; to provoke

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {刺激|しげき}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {刺激|しげき}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {刺激|しげき}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to stimulate; to excite; to inspire
definitions.explanation: To activate or arouse interest, motivation, or a physical response.

definitions.gloss: to irritate; to provoke; to aggravate
definitions.explanation: To cause discomfort, agitation, or an adverse reaction, either physically or emotionally.

examples.japanese: {好奇心|こうきしん}を{刺激|しげき}する。
{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}は{五感|ごかん}を{刺激|しげき}する。
examples.english: Traveling abroad stimulates all five senses.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}は{観客|かんきゃく}の{想像力|そうぞうりょく}を{大|おお}いに{刺激|しげき}した。
examples.english: That movie greatly stimulated the audience's imagination.

examples.japanese: {目|め}を{刺激|しげき}しないでください。
{辛|から}い{食|た}べ{物|もの}は{胃|い}を{刺激|しげき}する。
あまり{相手|あいて}を{刺激|しげき}しないように、{穏|おだ}やかに{話|はな}したほうがいい。
examples.english: You should speak calmly so as not to provoke the other person too much.

notes:
A word with both positive (stimulate, inspire) and negative (irritate, provoke) connotations depending on context. The noun form {刺激|しげき} is equally common and can function as a な-adjective ({刺激|しげき}{的|てき}な — stimulating).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刺激|しげき}を{受|う}ける: to receive stimulation
- {刺激|しげき}を{与|あた}える: to give stimulation
- {刺激|しげき}が{強|つよ}い: strongly stimulating
- {刺激|しげき}{的|てき}な: stimulating, exciting
- {経済|けいざい}を{刺激|しげき}する: to stimulate the economy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {促|うなが}す: to prompt, to urge — focuses on encouraging action
- {興奮|こうふん}させる: to excite — focuses on emotional arousal
- {触発|しょくはつ}する: to inspire, to trigger — more literary, implies sparking an idea
